attempted_claim: Let (M^4, pi0) be a compact Poisson 4-manifold with an isolated nondegenerate focus-focus rank-zero point p of Williamson type (0,0,1). Then the vanishing-cycle symplectic-area class in H^2_{pi0}(M,{p}) is nonzero, so no sufficiently small Poisson deformation splits p into two nondegenerate elliptic rank-zero points while preserving all nearby leafwise symplectic areas; any such splitting changes the Poisson moduli. An area-preserving splitting disproves the claim.
